scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --no-access-log
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env VITE_INTERVIEW_SERVICE=real VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort
